svg.text: The App and its cost view

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Your agent sends your code to its own provider,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: as it always does. QualityLayer does not change that.

svg.text: The licence and this machine's identity confirm access.

svg.text: App updates contact QualityLayer; workflow texts are local.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No usage events are queued or sent.

-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Own machines and paired browsers use local authentication.

svg.text: No hosted task, artifact or memory workspace.

svg.text: Feedback · only when you send it

svg.text: Your text, the screenshots you add and diagnostics you can read first,

svg.text: in a private issue. Never code, plan or document text, task titles,
